row.proto: int32_t Ne_Thread_WaitForMultipleObjects(void **waitables, uint64_t count, uint32_t timeout_ms, char wait_all, uint32_t *out_index)
row.notes: (lib) Collects native handles from up to 64 waitable objects (vtable +0x18), calls WaitForMultipleObjects and maps the result: 0 on signal (out_index set when not wait_all), 0x3c on timeout (0x102), 0x55 for an abandoned handle (index minus 0x80 written), 0x58 for an unexpected code, a translated GetLastError on failure, 0x21 when count exceeds 64.
